kurz: Toss pasta vigorously in the pan with a little starchy pasta water and fat. That makes a creamy sauce that clings to the pasta.
bild_im_kopf: Pasta water is the invisible glue between sauce and pasta.
was_passiert: Dissolved starch floats in the pasta water. It helps combine fat and water and thickens slightly as you toss. The movement spreads everything into fine droplets. The result is a glossy, bound sauce instead of separate oil and water.
faustregeln: Cooking pasta in less water gives starchier pasta water.
Too hot and the cheese clumps.
schritte: Drain the pasta 1–2 minutes before it is done and keep a cup of pasta water.
Add it to the pan with the sauce or fat.
Add a splash of pasta water and toss vigorously.
Work in cheese only over medium heat, adding more water as needed.
